questions.question: Surya is 25 years older than his son. In 5 years, he will be twice as old as his son. What will be Surya’s age after 3 years?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Age **difference** between two people always remains **constant** → 25 years.

In 5 years, Surya will be **twice** as old as his son → Ratio = 2 : 1.

Difference in ratio units = 2 − 1 = 1 unit → 25 years.

Surya’s age in 5 years = 2 units × 25 = 50 years.

Surya’s age after 3 years = 50 − 2 = 48 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Current age difference = 25 years

Condition after 5 years: Surya’s age = 2 × Son’s age

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0d61760dbb5e392dae22667ca4e71b272a03a18b22c2d2292b0139636391759.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **current age** of the son be x years.

⇒ Surya’s current age = x + 25 years.

⇒ After 5 years, Son’s age = x + 5

⇒ After 5 years, Surya’s age = (x + 25) + 5 = x + 30

⇒ According to the problem: x + 30 = 2 × (x + 5)

⇒ x + 30 = 2x + 10

⇒ 2x − x = 30 − 10

⇒ x = 20 years (Son’s current age).

⇒ Surya’s current age = 20 + 25 = 45 years.

⇒ Surya’s age after 3 years = 45 + 3 = 48 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 years.**

questions.question: B has 32 pens, 24 pencils and 16 erasers. How many sets of these three items can be made without any left over?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Find the **Highest Common Factor (HCF)** of the quantities: HCF(32, 24, 16) = 8.

Divide each item by the **HCF** to get the simplified ratio: 32÷8 = 4, 24÷8 = 3, 16÷8 = 2.

Sum the parts of the ratio to find the total items per set: 4 + 3 + 2 = 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of **pens** = 32

Number of **pencils** = 24

Number of **erasers** = 16

**Formula Used:**

To distribute items equally without any leftover, we find the **HCF**. The value is then determined by the sum of the reduced quantities: **Result** = (Σ Items) ÷ HCF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4bf8119166949f5b63e4275bd85542c83b139a6bc140752bf701084d81208b0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total items = 32 + 24 + 16 = 72

⇒ Prime factorization of 32 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2

⇒ Prime factorization of 24 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3

⇒ Prime factorization of 16 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2

⇒ **HCF** = 2 × 2 × 2 = 8

⇒ Reduced quantities for each item:

⇒ Pens per set = 32 ÷ 8 = 4

⇒ Pencils per set = 24 ÷ 8 = 3

⇒ Erasers per set = 16 ÷ 8 = 2

⇒ Total items in simplified grouping = 4 + 3 + 2 = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

**__Additional Information__**

HCF (Highest Common Factor)

It is the largest positive integer that divides each of the integers without a remainder. It is also known as the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD).

Ratio Simplification

A ratio is simplified by dividing all terms by their HCF. The sum of these simplified terms often represents the minimum number of items in a representative sample.

Equal Distribution Principle

When dividing multiple different quantities into identical groups with no leftovers, the number of groups is the HCF, and the sum of items per group is (Total Items) ÷ HCF.</p

Margin added by money changer = Rs 1.11 for each dollar

Whenever 1$ is converted to Rs, the money changer takes Rs 1.11 from that transaction.

So, in actual, after transaction, amount got to the user for 1$ = 67.89 - 1.11 = Rs 66.78

Then, for $150 = 150 × amount for $1 in INR

$150 = 150 × 66.78 = Rs 10,017

**∴ The cost of $150 is Rs 10,017.**

questions.question:
Which movement was called off following the violence at 'Chauri Chaura' incident?

A. Khilafat Movement

B. Quit India Movement

C. Non co-operation Movement

D. Home Rule Movement
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 3**__ i.e __**C**__.

__
 
• **Non-cooperation Movement:**

 
 
• The non-cooperation movement by Gandhiji was followed from September 1920 to February 1922. 
 
• Jallianwala Bagh Massacre in Amritsar in 1919 was one of the major reason for the start of the Non-cooperation movement.
 
• The **Chauri Chaura** **incident** occurred at Chauri Chaura in the Gorakhpur district (Uttar Pradesh) on 4 February 1922, when a large group of protesters, participating in the Non-cooperation movement, clashed with police, who opened fire.
 
 
• As the incident turned violent Mahatma Gandhi has **called off the ‘Non-cooperation Movement’**__ on 12 February 1922, as a direct result of this incident.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Quit India Movement:**
 
 
• In August 1942, Gandhiji started the 'Quit India Movement' and decided to launch a mass civil disobedience movement 'Do or Die' to call for an end to British rule in India. 
 
• The movement was also known as India August Movement or Bharat Chodo Andolan.
 
• It was launched on August 8, 1942, by the Mahatma Gandhi at the Bombay session of the All India Congress Committee (AICC).
 
 
 
• **Khilafat Movement:**
 
 
• The movement was started as an agitation by the Indian Muslims against the treatment accorded to the Ottoman Empire after World War I. 
 
• The Khilafat Movement begin in 1919 under the leadership of the Ali brothers; Maulana Muhammad Ali and Maulana Shaukat Ali. 
 
• By the mid-1920s, the Khilafat leaders joined hands with Gandhi's Non-Cooperation Movement.
 
 
 
• **Home rule movement**:
 
 
• Its objective was to establish self-government 
 
• Tilak started the movement in April 1916 while Annie Besant started in September 1916.
 
• Tilak’s movement was confined to Maharashtra and Karnataka. And the Annie Besant movement was spread to other parts of India.
